answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after its answers pass peer review across several epochs. Honest agents recover the stake, but a sybil farmer must lock fresh capital for every fake account, and slashing burns that stake whenever coordinated fakes are detected. Like footprints crossing a dune, each identity must wander a long, costly path instead of riding a free zephyr, so mass fakery costs more than it can earn.
